title: Adaptive Competitive Lighthouse for Regional Model Disruptions
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an automated 'Lighthouse' — a fused-signal monitoring and response playbook — that detects regional model availability degradations and competitor entrant events, prioritizes customer-impacted cohorts, and surfaces actionable alerts and runbooks in the Redwood Console. This ticket scopes the PM work to define signal sources, ranking heuristics, dashboard UX, and escalation playbooks; engineering tickets will implement ingestion and alerting pipelines; design tickets will propose Console affordances for operators and SREs.
goals: Create an extensible taxonomy of signals (model outages, price/quota changes, release cadence, latency spikes, provider notices)
Design a signal-fusion scoring heuristic that weights recency, geographic scope, and customer exposure to produce a single "Lighthouse Score" per territory
Define escalation playbooks and automated fallback recommendations (preferred model substitutes, routing policies, rollback suggestions)
Deliver Console dashboard mockups and an API contract for alerts to be consumed by SRE/PE teams
Prototype a minimal ingestion pipeline for 3 signal types (public status pages, telemetry anomalies, procurement feed)
acceptance_criteria: Signal taxonomy doc approved by GTM and SRE (Confluence link in links)
Ranking heuristic specified with test vectors and expected Lighthouse Scores for 10 synthetic incidents
Console mockups reviewed and signed off by Design and Console PM
Playbook steps documented for medium/high severity events with clear owner handoffs
Dependencies identified and engineering kickoff ticket created (ENG dependency keys in dependencies)
tasks: Collect candidate signal sources and sample data (public provider status pages, latency heatmap, billing change feed)
Work with Data Eng to outline required ingestion schemas and retention policy
Draft Lighthouse Score formula and sanity-check against historical incidents
Create Console mockups (alerts panel, regional map, incident drill-down) with Design
Write escalation playbook with runbook links and alerting thresholds
Coordinate with Sales/CS to identify 20 high-risk customers to surface as pilot recipients
Schedule cross-functional review and record decisions in meeting notes
